digest.component_or_area: CLI command dispatch and store initialization
propositions: Pure intercepts like verify-commit-ticket dispatch before centralized ensure_initialized and skip store mount, causing ticket store not found errors in fresh linked worktrees
Store mount logic is replicated per dispatch-arm and can be entirely skipped, making store-mount bugs structurally possible
Store mount (create_tracker symlink) must run at a single central CLI gate before both pure intercepts and set-based dispatch to guarantee no store-touching command skips it
Commands with policy=none (init, scratch, explain, pure no-store reads) must not be force-mounted and must continue working without a store
Per-arm ensure_initialized calls may remain as idempotent no-ops but the central gate guarantees mount coverage
Library and MCP intentionally do not auto-mount and require explicit init_repo or assume mounted store
